hero.title: Describe It. The Agent Does the Rest.
hero.description: Give a complex instruction in plain language. An autonomous agent plans it, executes across your business, and asks permission before anything risky.

intro: This is not a chatbot with API integrations. It's an autonomous agent framework with planning, approval gates, budget tracking, delegation, and fault recovery — operating across 87 business modules with row-level security. The architecture is comparable to enterprise workflow engines like ServiceNow or Salesforce Flow, but driven by natural language instead of drag-and-drop flowcharts. Active runs even survive server restarts.

pipeline.footer: The agent pauses at “Approve” for anything high-risk. You always have final say.

scenario.title: See it in action
scenario.instruction: “Analyze our Q1 revenue, find the 3 worst-performing products, and email the leadership team a summary.”

steps.text: Queries Finance module for Q1 revenue by product
Identifies bottom 3: Widget Pro (-23%), Basic Plan (-18%), Starter Kit (-12%)
Pauses — shows you the email draft for approval
You approve → Email sent to leadership

items.desc: Tasks that took a morning now take a single sentence.
Search, schedule, email, finance, bookings, research, tasks, reports — all at the agent's disposal.
Agents can spawn child agents with budget caps. Complex work, fully tracked.

closing.tagline: Other platforms automate simple triggers. VOIS agents think, plan, and execute.
